name: li-payroll-social
description: Prepare 2026 Liechtenstein payroll and social contribution workpapers. Covers AHV, IV, FAK and administration contributions (employee 4.9%, employer 7.385%), unemployment insurance ALV (0.5% each, capped at CHF 126,000 a year, CHF 350 a day for part years), the contribution wage and benefits in kind, self-employed contributions (12.285%, minimum CHF 368.55) and the 2026 table for non-employed persons, wage-tax withholding (the 4% to 19% maximum schedule, the CHF 25,200 student exemption), employer health-care contributions (CHF 180.50 a month), occupational pension entry (CHF 14,700, 8% minimum retirement contribution), accident premiums, remittance calendars, reminder fees and appeals. Trigger on: Liechtenstein payroll, AHV Liechtenstein, Lohnsteuer Liechtenstein, Quellensteuer, ALV, FAK, BPVG. Out of scope: disputed employment status, international insurance coordination and plan-specific premiums.
